documentation.content: A step of the daily ingestion workflow failed. Open Firestore `ingestRuns/<runId>` (the error says which run) or the Workflows execution for details. The previously published dataset stays live.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "workflows.googleapis.com/Workflow" AND resource.label.workflow_id = "ingest-daily" AND metric.type = "workflows.googleapis.com/finished_execution_count" AND metric.label.status = "FAILED"
